## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Lingo is a Duolingo-inspired design style. It combines minimal layouts with
bright colors, rounded shapes, and friendly illustrations for an engaging,
approachable interface. It uses clear structure and simple interactions with a
welcoming tone.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: bold, playful
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Nunito, display=Nunito,
  mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#58cc02, secondary=#ce82ff, success=#58cc02, warning=#ffc800,
  danger=#ff4b4b, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#3c3c3c
- Shadows: tactile three-dimensional bottom borders (for example, border-b-4)
  or soft drop shadows for interactive elements
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Playful, minimal design with bright colors, rounded shapes, tactile
three-dimensional borders,
and friendly illustrations for approachable interfaces.
